8_faq_set.q: Where is Brant Business Interiors located in Peterborough?
8_faq_set.a: We're headquartered at 701 The Queensway, Units 2-4 in Peterborough, Ontario. Peterborough is our home market — we supply, deliver and install commercial office furniture across Peterborough, the Kawarthas, Lakefield and Peterborough County, with our own crew. Call 1-800-835-9565 to plan a project or request a quote.

8_faq_set.q: Do you deliver and install office furniture across Peterborough?
8_faq_set.a: Yes. As a Peterborough-based dealer we handle the whole job locally — we quote it, schedule a delivery window, and our own crew places, assembles and levels every piece, then removes the packaging the same day. Coverage includes the Kawarthas, Lakefield and Peterborough County.

8_faq_set.q: Can Peterborough schools, hospitals and municipalities buy without a tender?
8_faq_set.a: Eligible Ontario broader-public-sector buyers — school boards, hospitals and municipalities, including those in Peterborough and the Kawarthas — can purchase office furniture and installation from us without an open tender under our OECM Supplier Partner agreement, held by our parent legal entity, Brant Basics. Private businesses simply order direct.

8_faq_set.q: How fast can you deliver in Peterborough?
8_faq_set.a: Lead times depend on the product, not the location, but Peterborough is our home market, so local orders get the shortest windows and warranty service we offer anywhere. Stock items typically deliver within one to two weeks; custom pieces run roughly four to twelve weeks by manufacturer. We confirm your window at order confirmation.

8_faq_set.q: What office furniture can you supply for a Peterborough workplace?
8_faq_set.a: Our full contract catalogue — ergonomic and executive seating, desks and height-adjustable workstations, boardroom and conference tables, reception furniture, storage and acoustic products, from the Canadian and contract brands we carry. Tell us the space and we'll spec it, then deliver and install it.
